name: 06-04-language-core-deepening
title: Deepen Chemd language core without device control
description: Deepen Chemd as a chemistry experiment programming language without IDE, training export, or device-control scope. Current phase adds procedure state/effect contracts and state-transition diagnostics.
creator: hzb666
notes: Phase 1 adds ProgramConditionExpression, parses procedure control condition strings into AST, validates references from AST, and carries structured conditions into canonical procedure controls. Phase 2 adds conservative condition expression type checking for incompatible runtime/reference/literal/quantity comparisons and registers E_CONDITION_TYPE_MISMATCH. Phase 3 adds procedure state/effect contracts, state tags, state violations, and E_PROCEDURE_STATE_INVALID diagnostics for missing mixture, post-quench active-reaction operations, and missing biphasic state. Verification: step-ontology/typechecker/compiler/cli/diagnostics tests, docs coverage tests, and package typechecks passed. pnpm lint remains blocked by ESLint 10.4.0 scopeManager.addGlobals toolchain failure.
